recognize_zh: 鐵染色高倍下，中央一顆巨噬細胞的細胞質含瀰漫藍色含鐵血黃素，並包住數顆紅色核的細胞，提示含鐵的噬血巨噬細胞；周圍散布藍色鐵顆粒。
features: Macrophage with diffuse blue hemosiderin-laden cytoplasm
Several red-counterstained nuclei enclosed within or overlying the macrophage, suggestive of engulfed cells
Extracellular clumps of blue iron nearby
Surrounding hematopoietic nuclei stained red by counterstain
Cytoplasmic detail limited by the iron stain
describe_en: Prussian blue-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage with abundant diffuse blue hemosiderin that appears to enclose several red-counterstained nuclei, suggestive of phagocytosed nucleated cells. Additional extracellular iron clumps are present nearby. Because the iron stain obscures cytoplasmic detail, true engulfment is best confirmed on a Wright-Giemsa smear. Findings are compatible with an iron-laden hemophagocytic macrophage as seen in hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Overlapping cells can mimic engulfment; Wright-Giemsa showing cells within vacuoles confirms hemophagocytosis.
Ringed sideroblasts are erythroblasts with perinuclear granules, not large macrophages with diffuse iron.
Iron overload shows increased macrophage iron without engulfed cells and with a history of transfusions.
